summary.text: Justin Pike is the Republican candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 42-Position 2, facing Democratic incumbent Joe Timmons in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes a career as a soldier, patrol officer and detective, and as a local business owner.

paragraphs.text: Pike's campaign website says he has spent his career meeting people on hard days, first as a soldier and then as a patrol officer and detective, and that his family has lived in Whatcom County for generations.
The site describes him as a local business owner.
Pike advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary with 46.1 percent of the vote to Timmons's 53.9 percent.

His campaign site lists three priorities: lowering the cost of housing, groceries, utilities and health care; supporting effective law enforcement, accountability for repeat offenders and better access to behavioral health and addiction treatment; and pushing for transparent budgets, responsible spending and measurable results.
